name: a name cloud of clients fades up with uneven emphasis
looks: A dense cluster of client or partner names fills the frame, most dimmed to low contrast, a few bold and in the accent colour as if highlighted, with a stat and caption settling beneath the cloud.
build: variant-stack-reveal, applied to inline text runs: each name fades in with a small seeded delay and a seeded opacity/weight target (most dim, a few full-bright), rather than a uniform reveal.
sound: A soft overlapping cluster of quiet pops.
prompt: Fill the frame with a dense cluster of names (clients, partners, tools), most dimmed low and a few bold in the accent colour as if singled out, all fading in with a small per-name stagger. Settle a supporting stat and caption beneath the cloud once it fills, to turn a name-drop into a credibility beat.
